rationale: I read the complete held EO 13018 (61 FR 49045, September 16, 1996): a single sentence changing the number 15 to 18 in the second sentence of section 3(a) of EO 12975 (National Bioethics Advisory Commission). I read the held EO 13137 (64 FR 50733): section 1 replaces section 3 of EO 12975 wholesale and section 2 adds a new section 4 with 'not more than 18 nongovernment members', so the text amended by EO 13018 was replaced in 1999. I read the held EO 13316 (68 FR 55255, September 17, 2003): section 3(b) revokes 'Executive Order 12975, as amended by Executive Orders 13018, 13046, and 13137, establishing the National Bioethics Advisory Commission'. With the parent order revoked and the amended sentence already replaced, EO 13018 has no continuing content; it contains no independent command. EO 13316 section 6 sets effective September 30, 2003 and has no savings clause for this order. The inference from revocation of the amended parent to the ending of the amending order is mine and should be tested by the reviewer; the catalog 'See: EO 13316' cross-reference alone would not support NO. Provisional NO hypothesis.
